title: Grateful Dead Live at Eureka Municipal Auditorium on 1968-01-20

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a jazzy, sophisticated 1968 suite featuring Clementine, New Potato, Born Cross‑Eyed and the rare Spanish Jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is a pristine soundboard source that lets every instrument shine, delivering crystal‑clear audio throughout. Musically the show is a pre‑1970 masterpiece – a thirty‑minute jazzy suite with standout performances of Clementine, New Potato, Born Cross‑Eyed and an unforgettable Spanish Jam that flows seamlessly into Dark Star material.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviewers gave 5‑star praise, emphasizing both superb soundboard quality and an exceptional, high‑energy performance with multiple rare jams.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix; reviewers note you can hear every instrument with no audible flaws or dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth, jazz‑inflected transitions; the suite moves effortlessly from Clementine into New Potato and then into rare jams, showcasing tight yet exploratory playing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Delivers a spacious New Potato sound; his guitar work is praised as deliberate and fitting the jazzy vibe.
band_member_comments.Phil: Wrote Clementine; his bass contributes to the Coltrane‑inspired jazz feel, highlighted by reviewers.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen on keyboards is at his best, providing rich textures throughout the performance.
